sql: SELECT c.date AS ds, SUM(s.sales) AS y FROM m5_sales_train s JOIN m5_calendar c ON s.d = c.d WHERE s.item_id = 'FOODS_3_540' AND s.store_id = 'CA_4' GROUP BY c.date ORDER BY c.date ASC
sql_explanation: Retrieves the daily sales (y) for product FOODS_3_540 at store CA_4 (filters) by joining the sales data (s) with the calendar (c). The results are grouped by date (ds) to prepare the time series for forecasting.
